question_text: Explain how to search a singly linked list for a specified product code and report failure if absent.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Set current=head. While current is not None, compare its code with the target; return/report found on equality, otherwise follow current.next. If current becomes None, report absent.
